title: Volume 1 Chapter 2: The Fourth Order's Helper Healer
content: I received a strange invitation from Lady Rana.
To become the healer of the Fourth Knight Order and to be allowed to interact with any of the girls.
I can't understand what nobles are thinking, but I got angry in the heat of the moment.
What am I doing?
Even though it means she trusts me that much, I misunderstood and thought I was treating the Knight Order members like objects.
After that, Lady Freina mediated, and the discussion about me working as the Knight Order healer fell through, but I honestly think it was a missed opportunity.

If I were told that I could become the exclusive healer for a knight order full of beautiful girls, and that I had the endorsement of the acting lord to do whatever I wanted, I would definitely be tempted.
But I can't shake the feeling that there's something behind it.
Unfortunately, nobles are all about probing each other's intentions, and I believe Lady Rana is scheming something while observing my reactions.
Ugh, what a huge missed opportunity!
I'm such an idiot.
This is exactly why I was unpopular in my previous life; I'm really hopeless.
Back at the luxurious inn, I rolled around on the bed, repeatedly recalling what I had messed up and regretting that I could have responded better.
Lady Rana didn't get angry about my outburst and even gave me a week to respond.
Despite being younger than me, she has such composure, and I really don't know what I'm doing.
However, the offer is just too tempting, so I can't help but be cautious.
The situation is different from Asha being scouted by the Knight Order.
This time, it seems like they're trying to offer me a stable job as a thank you for helping the Knight Order members.
I also have a desire to have a stable job.
It's better to retire from the dangerous work of being an adventurer sooner rather than later.
There's no denying that becoming a solo adventurer increases the risks.
This invitation is particularly concerning because it's a knight order full of women.
Since I have the Holy Attribute, my healing power is weaker compared to those with the Healing Attribute.
As long as the miasma is rampant, I will be treated as a valuable asset, but once the miasma disappears, I'll be discarded.
As an adventurer, I can travel through lands where miasma is prevalent.
Thanks to the revival of some memories from my previous life, I believe I understand the structure of human relationships.
It's not that having a Holy Attribute is completely unheard of.
Basically, the Holy Attribute often falls under the jurisdiction of the church.
It's a rare existence among the thirteen attributes, and the church likely wants to keep someone who can counter the Death Attribute close.
However, I couldn't just join the church and abandon Asha and Cynthia.
As an adventurer, I could freely protect the two of them.
That's why I chose to be an adventurer.
...Knock, knock.
As I was contemplating my future course of action, there was a knock on the door.
Could it be dinner, just like yesterday?
Before I realized it, the sun had tilted outside the window, and it was evening.
It seems that time had passed while I was lost in thought after returning to the inn.
Could it be room service again? I don't think I'll be swept away this time since I'm not as tired as yesterday...
"Lord Salt, it's Freina Alban. The captain of the Fourth Knight Order."
"Eh!? Lady Freina Alban!"
I hurriedly opened the door.
Instead of the knight order uniform from lunch, Lady Freina stood at the door in a comfortable outfit of pants and a shirt.
"I just parted ways with you a moment ago, but is it alright?"
"Yes, would you like to come in?"
"No, I'm not that careless. It's about to be night, so I’ll refrain from entering a man's room."
"Oh! I didn't realize that, I'm sorry."
I was still in my formal attire from lunch, having not changed.
I didn't want to dirty it, but I didn't have clothes suitable for walking outside with Lady Freina, so I decided to go out as I was.
"Where are you going?"
"I'd prefer not to walk around too much and be teased by the members. Would the lounge in this inn be alright?"
"Of course."
We walked together toward the inn's lounge.
The lounge on the top floor was high enough to see the lights of the city.
"It's beautiful."
"Heh, thank you. It's strangely pleasant to hear that from you."
I intended to compliment the night view, but it seems I was misunderstood.
Well, even in casual attire, Lady Freina is beautiful.
Her short red hair is neatly trimmed, and she possesses a dignified coolness alongside her femininity.
"Lady Alban, do you come here often?"
Occasionally.
I can't take the members out, so I only come when I want to enjoy a drink alone.
By the way, I'm not used to being called Alban.
If you don't mind, I’d prefer you to call me Freina.
"Is that alright? Well, I don't have a family name, so I'm Salt. Feel free to call me by my name."
"Haha, thank you. Then I'll call you Salt. Please call me Freina as well."
"Then only at this drinking occasion. Freina, nice to meet you."
"Ah, this is nice and relaxed. You should also feel at ease, Salt."

"Freina! Are you conscious?"
I rushed to her side, feeling panic rise within me.
She lay on the ground, her face pale and her breathing shallow.
"Ugh... Salt..."
Her voice was weak, but she was still alive.
"Stay with me! I’ll heal you right now!"
I quickly placed my hands over her wounds, channeling my magic.
"《キュアヒール》! 《エリアキュアヒール》!"
The healing light enveloped her, and I focused on purging the toxins from her body.
"Ugh... It hurts..."
Freina grimaced, but I pressed on, determined to save her.
"Just hold on a little longer!"
As the magic flowed, I could feel her condition stabilizing.
Her breathing became steadier, and the color began to return to her face.
"Thank you... Salt..."
She managed a weak smile, but I knew we weren’t out of danger yet.
"Freina, you need to get up! We have to deal with that monster!"
I glanced back at the giant snake that was still looming over us, its massive form coiling and ready to strike.
"Right... I can still fight..."
Freina pushed herself up, her determination shining through the pain.
"Stay behind me, and let me handle this!"
I nodded, readying myself to support her.
The snake hissed, venom dripping from its fangs as it prepared to attack again.
"Everyone, regroup!" Freina shouted, her voice strong despite her injuries.
The remaining knights quickly formed a line, weapons drawn, ready to face the beast.
"Salt, keep healing us as we fight! We can’t let it get close!"
"Understood!"
I focused on maintaining my magic, ready to heal anyone who fell.
Freina charged forward, her sword ignited with flames, and the other knights followed her lead.
"Now!"
With a coordinated effort, they launched their attacks, trying to distract the snake and create an opening.
I watched as Freina dodged the snake's strikes, her movements graceful and precise.
"《ピュリファイ》!"
I cast the purification spell again, clearing the air of toxins, giving my allies a better chance to fight.
The snake roared in anger, thrashing wildly as it tried to shake off the knights attacking it.
"Keep it distracted!" Freina yelled, her voice cutting through the chaos.
I could see the determination in her eyes, and it fueled my own resolve.
"Let’s finish this!"
With renewed energy, the knights pressed their attack, and I continued to heal and support them from the back.
"Freina, watch out!"
I shouted as the snake lunged toward her, but she was quick, rolling to the side just in time.
"Thanks, Salt!"
She retaliated, striking the snake's side with her sword, causing it to recoil.
"Now's our chance!"
I saw an opening and focused my magic.
"《キュアヒール》!"
I healed the knights who had taken damage, ensuring they could keep fighting.
The battle raged on, but with each passing moment, the snake began to weaken.
"Let’s finish it!" Freina shouted, rallying her comrades.
With one final push, they attacked together, their combined strength overwhelming the beast.
The snake let out a final roar before collapsing to the ground, defeated.
"We did it!"
Cheers erupted from the knights, and I felt a wave of relief wash over me.
Freina turned to me, her expression a mix of exhaustion and gratitude.
"Thank you, Salt. I couldn’t have done it without you."
I smiled back, feeling a sense of pride in what we had accomplished together.
"Just doing my job."
But deep down, I knew this was more than just a job.
I had found a place where I could truly make a difference, and I was grateful for the chance to fight alongside them.
As the sun began to set, casting a warm glow over the battlefield, I felt a sense of camaraderie with the knights around me.
We had faced danger together and emerged victorious, and I knew this was just the beginning of our adventures.
At my call, Freina nodded her head.
Thirty percent of her body was burned.
I immediately began casting Healing Magic, but it was taking longer than I hoped.
“May, it’s going to take time to treat Freina. Buy us a little more time.”
“Got it! Leave it to me!”
May readily accepted my request.
I knew I was asking for too much. Krush had said that May wasn’t reliable in combat.
But I couldn’t let Freina head back into battle in her current state.
If only she could buy us some time…
“《Wind》!”
It seemed May had a wind attribute.
While it wasn’t particularly impressive, she created gusts of wind that blew away the poisonous mist.
Perhaps her actions inspired the other members, as those who could move rallied to support her.
“Alright!”
With the time she bought, I was able to finish most of Freina’s treatment.
She looked beautiful again, just like before.
“Lord Salt.”
“Leave the rest to me. Poison and death are under the jurisdiction of the Holy Attribute.”
I laid Freina down and slowly stood up.
“May! You’re amazing. You did your job well.”
“Of course! I’m a member of the Fourth Knight Order too!”
“Yeah, that’s right. From here on, it’s my job.”
I activated Purification Magic and created a barrier around myself.
I approached the poisonous snake that was trying to intimidate us with its poisonous breath.
“Salt-san?”
I heard May’s voice, but it didn’t matter.
As I got closer, the poisonous snake swelled up and, in the next moment, spewed out a massive cloud of poisonous mist.
“《Purify》!”
I cast Purification Magic on the poison mist and the snake.
The poisonous mist was cleansed in an instant.
“Awesome!”
A voice of admiration came from one of the members, pushing me forward.
It wasn’t that impressive.
Compared to Freina, who had fought at the front without regard for danger, I was just a pathetic man relying on my attributes.
The snake seemed to feel it was at a disadvantage and leaped high into the air.
“Ugh…!”
Seeing it head towards the fallen Freina and the injured, my emotions exploded for a moment.
“Are you only capable of targeting the weak?!”
The power of the Holy Attribute’s purification could cleanse anything, be it poison or death.
“Freina!”
I poured my Holy Attribute magic into a 《Holy Cross》 spell.
The giant poisonous snake, leaping through the air, lunged at Freina and bit into her as she lay there.
In that instant, it was purified by my Holy Cross, and its body shrank down.
“《Sacred Cross》!”
I unleashed a powerful purification spell, completely annihilating the poisonous snake.
It would be troublesome if it regained its strength in the same way.
“I did it!”
May cheered in triumph.
But just after that, Freina’s condition suddenly worsened.
Blood was flowing from her shoulder where the snake had bitten her.
“Freina!”
I rushed over to her, quickly removing the snake’s fangs from her wound.
I applied purification and made her drink a blood coagulant through mouth-to-mouth.
Her complexion was pale, and her breathing was rapid. Not yet! I absolutely wouldn’t let her die!
I used Healing Magic to close her wound.
“Close up quickly!”
As someone without the Healing Attribute, my recovery speed was painfully slow.
Even so, I managed to stop Freina’s bleeding.
However, I still hadn’t purified all the poison in her body.
“《Purify》!”
I tried to remove the poison with Purification Magic, but there was too much poison for a single casting to suffice.
“Just a little more… Hang in there, Freina!”
I anxiously poured the antidote into her wound.
Her face twisted in pain, but she was still conscious.
“Lord Salt… I trust you…”
Freina’s voice echoed weakly.
I held her hand tightly and desperately continued the Healing Magic.
“It’s alright, I’ll definitely save you… I won’t let you die…!”
I chanted 《Purify》 and 《Heal》 repeatedly, gradually removing the poison from her body.
Finally, Freina’s breathing began to stabilize, and her complexion slowly improved.
“...Thank goodness.”
I let out a deep sigh, relaxing my shoulders.
Freina still looked pained, but she was no longer in critical condition.
“Thank you, Lord Salt… truly…”
Freina expressed her gratitude in a raspy voice.
I gently squeezed her hand back and replied with a smile.
“Of course. I’m the healer of the Fourth Knight Order, after all.”
Freina managed to stabilize her condition.
Once again, I collapsed, having exhausted all my strength.
Even so, I felt satisfied with the work I had done.
